task.title: Make RuntimeBinding an executable artifact projection contract

scope.owned_layer: Executable artifact projection contract for RuntimeBinding, verifying artifact loading, checksum, strategy parameters, and paper signal generation integration.
not_changing: Existing deployment dispatcher and Runtime Manager ownership

composes_with.upstream: DeploymentPlan and Registry artifact projection contract
composes_with.downstream: PaperSignalProducer (Loop 8) and LEAN paper signal consumer (Loop 9)

normal_path_proof.mode: deterministic isolated unit and integration test suite
verified_contracts: ArtifactLoader validates metadata, checksum, strategy_id, version, and execution_mode boundaries.
ArtifactLoader load_exact verifies registry_id, strategy_id, version, and artifact_checksum alignment.
CurrentArtifactStrategy in PaperSignalProducer evaluates approved artifact projections without hardcoded BUY/SELL fallbacks.
Deployment saga and RuntimeManager client/adapter validate authoritative readback.

acceptance.statement: Approved immutable artifact storage identity checksum interpreter and paper market-input policy flow from Registry through DeploymentPlan into RuntimeBinding
Runtime Manager fails closed before active when an execution-required projection is missing or caller-authored
the existing deployment dispatcher and Runtime Manager remain the only owners
Loop 8 terminal readback records the executable binding and its Loop 9 receipt

safety.runtime_binding_write_owner: Runtime Manager remains sole write owner.

review.required_review: Verify evidence manifest, executable RuntimeBinding contract alignment, and test suite execution results.
